scope:
Replay unchanged canonical hardware programs across explicit physical profiles.

The optional functional frontend resolves actual data-dependent instructions
once per input. It supplies concrete control/memory footprints, never timing.
Every candidate then runs the existing native component LPN on those commands.

hardware_instructions.input_interface: Canonical openTPU hardware instructions, eight 32-bit words each
hardware_instructions.matrix_arithmetic: Quantized integer dots with FP32 epilogues, not a native BF16 matrix datapath
hardware_instructions.counting_scope: Two dot operations per MAC; includes encoded K padding and dynamic loop iterations; no model shape estimates
exclusions: Matrix FP32 scale/accumulation epilogues and quantizer arithmetic are not counted as FLOPs
Vector counts are mathematical operations, excluding physical reduction padding
Special functions, comparisons and copies are not converted into FLOPs
